clusters.headline: Donald Trump And Qatar Discuss Potential End To Iran Conflict
aiSummaryBullets: President Donald Trump met with the Qatari Prime Minister to discuss strategies for concluding the war with Iran.
The administration indicated that fresh military strikes are unlikely to be ordered as long as diplomatic negotiations continue.

clusters.headline: Explosions Reported In Strait Of Hormuz Amidst Diplomatic Efforts
aiSummaryBullets: Explosions were reported on Qeshm Island and on tankers following encounters with sea mines in the Strait of Hormuz.
Iran has officially removed the previous 2,000-kilometer range restriction on its ballistic missile program.
